_meta.source: https://ai.google.dev/pricing (Google AI API pricing — agy routes to same models)
_meta.billing_model: Google AI subscription / per-token via Antigravity
notes: agy is the sole Gemini CLI since the standalone gemini binary retired June 18 2026.
Thinking level (Low/Medium/High) is part of the model identity in agy — see display_name.
Flash is designed for speed, coding, tool use, and agentic workflows. Pro is for deep reasoning.
Flash is ~4x faster (tokens/sec) and cheaper per token than Pro.
Flash with high thinking levels can inflate tokens via Thought Preservation — use Low for CLI dispatch.
Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite not available in agy as of 2026-06-28.
Gemini 3.1 Pro real Google API model ID: gemini-3.1-pro-preview. agy CLI uses display name 'Gemini 3.1 Pro (Low/High)'.
Gemini 3.1 Pro has a long context tier: >200K tokens input triggers higher pricing ($4.00 vs $2.00/1M).
